remarks: Step into your new home in the picturesque, large and bright gated community of Chesterfield! This charming 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhome is ideally located within walking distance of Ridgeway Center, Downtown Stamford, and Bulls Head shopping centers. The inviting main floor showcases a vaulted ceiling and a modern kitchen equipped with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. You'll find a main floor bedroom with sliding doors that open to a lovely private balcony, along with a full bathroom accessible both from the bedroom as well as living room.  Head upstairs to discover a versatile open loft with skylights, perfect for an office, a workout area, or whatever suits your lifestyle. The generous primary bedroom features an updated bathroom complete with a soaking tub, separate shower, and double vanity. Additional perks include walk-in closets, an assigned garage space, and access to the community pool, not to mention plenty of parking for you and your guests. Laundry in the loft area. Don't let this wonderful opportunity pass you by!
